title: [Radio’Clock] KOREAPEDIA with GHOST9 #Korean characters
description:
DJ 애슐리의 빈자리를 채우기 위해 일일 DJ가 된 프린스와 준형!
엄청난 능숙함은 아니지만, 두 사람이 가득채운 한 시간!

 두 사람이 봤을지,, 알고는 있을지 궁금했던 한국의 캐릭터들!
귀여운 캐릭터들에 대해서 알아봤습니다!
여러분이 어릴 때 봤던 캐릭터들은 어떤게 있었나요?
 
Prince and Junhyung became special DJs to fill in DJ Ashley's spot!
Although they may not be highly skilled, they filled the hour with their presence!

Many adorable Korean characters were introduced this week,
which made us wonder if Prince and Junhyung had seen or heard about them before.
What were some characters you saw when you were younger?
